summary: The Fix Our Forests Act expedites hazardous fuels reduction and forest restoration on federal and tribal lands by designating high-risk fireshed areas for streamlined environmental reviews, expanded categorical exclusions, and collaborative projects.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes multiple new federal programs, centers (e.g., Fireshed Center), initiatives, pilot projects, and expanded authorities for forest management activities. These provisions require new administrative structures, staffing, technical services, and funding mechanisms, which inherently expand federal government spending rather than reducing it.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, tax credits, or revenue collection.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare coverage, delivery, or policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill contains no provisions related to immigration, border security, or pathways to citizenship.
The bill contains no provisions related to abortion access or restrictions.
The bill contains no provisions that alter military or defense spending levels.

The bill primarily focuses on expediting forest management by creating categorical exclusions under NEPA, streamlining environmental reviews and litigation, expanding hazardous fuels reduction projects, and limiting certain regulatory processes. This directly limits environmental regulations to accelerate on-the-ground actions.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs, food assistance, or social safety net expansions or reductions.
The bill contains no provisions related to public schools, school choice, or federal education policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to drug enforcement, decriminalization, or legalization.
The bill contains no provisions related to sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
The bill contains no provisions related to tariffs, trade agreements, or globalization.
The bill contains no provisions that directly address deficit spending, debt reduction targets, or fiscal policy regarding the national debt.
The bill contains no provisions related to legal protections or restrictions for LGBTQ+ individuals.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign aid or international assistance.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access, voter ID, or election integrity.
The bill contains no provisions related to data privacy, tech regulation, or oversight of technology companies.
The bill contains no provisions related to worker protections, union rights, or employer flexibility.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or civil rights enforcement.
